reconstruction_summary: Reconstructed agent's recommended V1+V3+V4 stack: V3 = linear single-track yaw rate with fit C_alpha_f=312267 and C_alpha_r=318880 (from out/ladder_results.json) on canonical Mach-E PARAM_BY_PLATFORM constants, plus per-segment straight-line yaw bias correction (V1), plus a Ridge (alpha=1) residual learner on [v, |a_y|, |delta|, sign(d_delta/dt)] fit on the agent's original 80 Mach-E training segments and applied as a single production model (LOO collapsed to single fit since canonical segments are unseen).
notes: Baseline V0 matches canonical to 1e-15. Agent's model is platform-specific to FORD_MUSTANG_MACH_E_MK1 (fit C_alpha and Ridge trained only on Mach-E segments) so applying it across the canonical pool (which includes 230 FORD_F_150_LIGHTNING_MK1 segments using Mach-E geometry and dynamics) produces a large regression vs V0. Agent's self-reported headline (19% relative improvement on first 80 Mach-E segments) is not portable to the canonical pooled Ford set; on Mach-E alone the improvement direction matches the agent's report, but pooled cross-platform RMSE worsens by ~50%. Per-segment straight-line bias is computed from each canonical segment's own straight samples (a procedure the agent ships, not memorised coefficients).
